protocol: research_v3 CN transfer test of frozen candidate CAP_DEF_M (T40)
purpose: Out-of-market test: apply the frozen rule unchanged to a pre-declared China A-share ETF universe. No parameter, rule or universe changes after this file is committed. Results are recorded whatever they are.

rule_unchanged.cadence: monthly matched (same construction as research_v2 build_monthly_matched_schedule, on the XSHG calendar)
rule_unchanged.momentum_definition: identical to research_v2 compute_weekly_momentum (same anchor/skip convention)
rule_unchanged.cap_rule: at most 1 selected asset per group; walk momentum ranking of trend-passing assets, skip assets whose group already has a selection; tie-break = universe order below
rule_unchanged.slots: def: each of 3 slots = 1/3; unfilled slots go to DEFENSIVE_BOND if its 3-month total return (anchor to signal close, no skip) is strictly greater than the cash return over the same window, else CASH
rule_unchanged.execution: next XSHG session open after the signal close

mapping_from_us_to_cn.cash: accrues 3-month SHIBOR (maps 13-week T-bill ^IRX); simple money-market convention: daily accrual = rate(previous session) * calendar_days / 365; forward-fill from earlier values only; fail if none
deviations_declared_in_advance: US universe has 8 assets incl. TLT; CN universe has 6. No long-duration bond ETF with history from 2013 exists (511260 starts 2017-08), so BONDS has only 511010.
No QDII/cross-border ETFs, to avoid premium-to-NAV distortions.
Prices are exchange trading prices (not NAV), adjusted for distributions (hfq/back-adjusted total return) for signals and returns; execution at the adjusted open, same as v2's adj_open convention.
T+1 does not bind: signals use close, trades execute at the next session open, and no position is sold the day it was bought.

Daily price limits and suspensions are not modelled; any session where a held or target asset has no bar is handled the way research_v2 handles missing prices (fail-closed), and every such event is counted and reported.
Cost 5+5 bps kept unchanged even though A-share ETF commissions/spreads differ; a sensitivity row with 10+10 bps is reported as secondary, not used for any decision.

sample.data_start: earliest date when all 6 ETFs have bars (expected 2013-07/08, determined by 518880 listing)
sample.warmup: no scoring until momentum (12 months) and trend (40 weeks) are computable for all assets
sample.score_end: last complete month available at run time, not later than 2026-09-30
sample.note: No partition is used for selection; all are evaluation.

benchmarks.CSI300_BH: 100% 510300 buy and hold from first monthly execution session
benchmarks.CN_60_40: 60% 510300 / 40% 511010, rebalanced on the same monthly execution sessions
benchmarks.BASE_M_CN: secondary context only: research_v2 BASE monthly T40 rule (top 3, renormalised, no CAP, no DEF) on the same CN universe
benchmarks.costs_and_cash: same engine, costs and cash accrual as the strategy

metrics: stationary block bootstrap 90% CI of excess Sharpe difference vs CN_60_40 and vs CSI300_BH (block 21, 2000 resamples, seed 20261019)

transfer_supported_if_all: FULL excess Sharpe of CAP_DEF_M > CN_60_40
FULL max drawdown of CAP_DEF_M < CSI300_BH max drawdown
SUB_A and SUB_B excess Sharpe of CAP_DEF_M both > CN_60_40 (point estimates)
success_criteria_declared_in_advance.statistical_note: Point estimates only; the bootstrap CI is reported and a CI including 0 must be stated as 'not statistically distinguishable'.

outcomes.PARTIAL: drawdown criterion met but at least one Sharpe criterion failed, or vice versa
outcomes.NOT_SUPPORTED: neither the drawdown criterion nor the FULL Sharpe criterion met

freeze_rule: This protocol and the CN rule are frozen at commit time. Any later change is a new, separately labelled experiment.
